Salutations to my friend in change

Here a recipe for bold results

Eternal fiend writhes and consults

Empire he commands us rearrange

Rites complex with ingredients strange

At nine monthsninth assemble nine cults

Run priests blood so the changer exults

Great rune maul and confusion exchange

Each eye present a horror become

Then form fates grasp beliver the task

Regents shell feather and twist undone

Utter ninetimes swiftly iztak graksk
